evidence_method: READ_ONLY_SOURCE_AND_WORKFLOW_INSPECTION_ONLY; AST SYNTAX/ASSERT-ROSTER INSPECTION; NO CHECKER EXECUTION

fixed_issue.reason: Both optimization directories must match the exact eighteen expected filenames before any arrays are loaded. All expected names are subsequently read exactly once; extra/missing names raise ValueError. The prior missing scalar plus replacement preflight-7-1 case fails the exact set gate, independently of total count.
fixed_issue.historical_source_scope: The original archived reader/result remains unchanged; this new checker is a separate reusable route. Historical false coverage reproduction was reported by root, not executed by this reviewer.

checks.reason: All validation uses explicit require/check raising ValueError. AST contains no Assert nodes; Python optimization does not erase these checks.
Exact two Times, Time-only variable dimensions, 0-space-space MemoryOrder bytes, signed INTEGER32 dtype and [-17,2033] values are independently checked.
Recovery Times/shape/both values, ZZ Times/axis order/MemoryOrder/shape/two records and malformed attributes retain the intended oracles.

netcdf_file opens read-only without mmap; each file is SHA-checked before/after. CLI rejects existing/symlink output and output resolving inside the declared input root, then creates output exclusively. The checker has no input write call; this is not a broader filesystem symlink/inode provenance proof.

Standalone-columns already installs NumPy/SciPy, generates serial O0/O2 files with the actual backend fixture, then calls the new checker against build/netcdf-zz. External receipt is uploaded with existing logs using the always artifact step. Default step success semantics stop a failed checker from appearing successful.

scope_notes.note: Only scalar storage dtype is explicitly checked. Recovery/ZZ equality does not independently enforce dtype or FieldType attribute. Do not describe this source as independently checking storage dtype of every variable/file. It does not invalidate the native backend fixture checks or current saved outputs.
scope_notes.optional_meaningful_control: If broad independent storage-type coverage is desired, create a fresh copied fixture with integer recovery/ZZ data stored as float/double but same exact numeric values and unchanged metadata; require failure from explicit dtype/type-attribute checks. Not performed by reviewer.

scope_notes.note: Path.is_file follows symlinks. The exact roster proves expected names with regular-file targets, not absence of symlinked files/directories or cross-mode aliases. The CI fixture uses freshly generated files; no current incorrect input was observed or inferred. A no-symlink/path-containment guarantee would require separate checks.

verdict_ko: 새 checker의 최적화별18개 exact-roster 검사가 실제 재현된 누락/대체 파일의 false coverage 경로를 차단하며 CI 입력·의존성·외부 receipt upload 결속이 맞다. 소스 검토 범위 PASS다. 독립 dtype 검사는 scalar에 한정되고 symlink 배제까지 증명하지 않는다. 신규 실행·물리 승인은 아니다.
